# Out of area

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Patients in a bed outside their home health service, with days away and any return plan.

## What is on the screen

1. Away from home. How many people are in a bed outside their home health service, split by days away. Checking counts discharge dates passed and missing return plans.
2. Quick views. Discharge date passed, no plan and the long trips home. Each narrows the list.
3. Views. Away now and History. On a phone: My list, Everyone and Beds.
4. The list. Each person's home region, placement and discharge date. When nobody is listed, one line says why.
5. Return plan. Choose a person and their return plan opens in a side panel: receiving bed, transport and dispatch.

## On a phone

- My list. Leaving today, Ready to go home, then the people whose return date is in the next 2 days. Open a person for their return plan.

## Jobs done here

- Plan a patient's return home. Open Out of area and choose the person. In the return plan, choose the receiving bed, then transport and legal status, then the CAD number and depart time. Record sent to ward once the ward is asked, and Record return once they are home.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
